remarks: Experience the ultimate downtown lifestyle in this stunning New Canaan Townhouse. Discover vibrant town living in this beautifully renovated townhouse, perfectly located in the heart of New Canaan. Enjoy award-winning restaurants, a variety of upscale shops, a brand-new movie theater, state-of-the-art recreational facilities, and the town's cutting-edge new library-all just steps from your door. With easy access to the train, a quick commute to NYC is at your fingertips. This townhouse presents a carefree lifestyle, featuring fresh, modern finishes throughout. The bright, airy interior showcases a stunning white kitchen, two fully updated baths, gorgeous light hardwood floors, and chic shiplap accents. The spacious living area includes a wall of built-ins, all-new lighting, and in-unit laundry for added convenience. Step outside to your private deck, perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. With low monthly HOA, reserved parking, and a prime downtown location, this home is ideal for first-time buyers, empty nesters, or those seeking a second home. Don't miss this rare opportunity to enjoy premium New Canaan living at an exceptional price point.
